source.$capturesNote: Raw get_metadata responses, committed verbatim, so both the screen list and the documentation frame list are DERIVED rather than asserted. The verifier re-derives each and compares. It does not prove the canvases were read in full — nothing available at verification time can — but it does mean the lists and the document are checked against the same captured artefact rather than against the author's memory. Deleting a frame from the manifest no longer hides it: the captured list is the authority and the manifest must match it exactly.

openItems.$comment: Found by a roast, not by me. DESIGN.md carried 'The Review fields are provisional until the Job Record shape is finalised' in section 3 with no task and no cross-reference, and the verifier passed because it only parsed section 6. The item is real: which fields the Review step shows is a design decision nobody has made.

Found by a roast reading the committed capture rather than the document. DESIGN.md said all sixteen copy changes in 505:3 were applied and that nothing was left in the Figma file alone. Both were false: two of the sixteen say inside the frame that they were not applied.

$capturePendingNote: Every place the CAPTURES themselves say something is unsettled, derived by scanning the committed XML for the Persian vocabulary of a pending item and then recorded here with its disposition. This is the half the English scan of DESIGN.md cannot do: DESIGN.md can only be checked for what it says, whereas the source can be checked for what it says is missing. The verifier re-derives this set and requires it to match exactly in both directions, so a pending marker in the design cannot be absorbed by silence.
